Question: Let $(X,\Delta)\to Z\ni o$ be a log Fano fibration germ. Write $\Val_{X,o}^*$ for the nontrivial valuations on $X$ centered over $o$, and for $v\in\Val_{X,o}^*$ write $\mathbf H(v):=\mathbf H(\mathcal F_v)$ for the $\mathbf H$-functional of the filtration induced by $v$. Let $\mathbf H(X,\Delta)$ denote the minimum value of the invariant $\mathbf H(v)$ over $v\in\Val_{X,o}^*$. Which description gives the complete characterization of the minimizers of $\mathbf H$?
Predicted label: 'E'
Predicted text: 'They form a single quasi-monomial ray: there exists a quasi-monomial valuation $v_0\\in\\Val_{X,o}^*$ such that $\\mathbf H(v)=\\mathbf H(X,\\Delta)$ if and only if $v=a\\,v_0$ for some $a\\in\\mathbb R_{>0}$; uniqueness holds only after normalizing $v$.'
Correct label: 'C'
Correct text: 'They consist of exactly one valuation: there exists a unique quasi-monomial valuation $v_0\\in\\Val_{X,o}^*$ such that $\\mathbf H(v_0)=\\mathbf H(X,\\Delta)$.'
Exact Match: 0.0
